crew.overview: A tenacious attorney uncovers a dark secret that connects a growing number of unexplained deaths to one of the world's largest corporations. In the process, he risks everything — his future, his family, and his own life — to expose the truth.
crew.title: Dark Waters

crew.overview: In the late 1960s, the Beach Boys' Brian Wilson stops touring, produces "Pet Sounds" and begins to lose his grip on reality. By the 1980s, under the sway of a controlling therapist, he finds a savior in Melinda Ledbetter.
crew.title: Love & Mercy

crew.overview: Abandoned by her father, a young woman embarks on a thousand-mile odyssey through the backroads of America where she meets a disenfranchised drifter. But despite their best efforts, all roads lead back to their terrifying pasts and to a final stand that will determine whether their love can survive their otherness.
crew.title: Bones and All

details.biography: Sam Patton grew up in Northern Kentucky, outside of Cincinnati, Ohio. He graduated from Ithaca College in 2012 and began his career that year as an intern at the micro-budget hit factory Blumhouse Productions. He produced and directed his first feature film in 2017, the contained environs horror film DESOLATION which was released by IFC Midnight. After a decade in Production Accounting, he has spent the last several years working as a Production Supervisor. He has come to specialize in low budget movies from 2-20 million, and in tax incentives across the United States.
details.name: Sam Patton
